name: aws-sdlc
description: Lifecycle-first skills for building on AWS. One skill per SDLC phase - intent, build, verify, operational readiness review (ORR), deploy, and maintain - plus an entry router. Each phase runs a short workflow, hands off to the next phase through .aws-sdlc/ artifacts, and routes to the domain skills in aws-core (and other toolkit plugins) for service-level depth. Recommends options with trade-offs instead of prescribing services. Works best with the aws-core plugin installed.

interface.shortDescription: Take an AWS workload from intent to production and keep it running.
